posts.cooked:
Maybe it'd be fun to keep the chit-chat going by speculating which "variant packs" we'll get next, which ones we're most looking forward to, what their unlock conditions might be like, etc. Here's what I think are the missing variants for the folks already in the game so far:

  • Termi-Nation: AZ, Bunker, Unity
  • Freedom Five: AZ, Bunker, Legacy, Tachyon, Wraith
  • XTreme Prime Wardens: Argent, Cosmic, Fanatic, Haka, Tempest
  • Dark Conductor Argent Adept (another one I'm curious about the SFX for...)
  • Requital Captain Cosmic
  • Extremist Sky-Scraper
  • Best of Times Chrono-Ranger
  • Setting Sun Ra
  • Visionary Unleashed
  • Completionist Guise

I'm betting either Termi-Nation or Freedom Five next, with Termi-Nation being what I hope for (Unity!)
